The maximum

MX-01 / One file

Your personal file sets what every company you own qualifies for, through one card on it.

Which card it is, its limit and how long it's been open are printed on your report today.

  • Off my own personal file, four different companies each got a $100,000 line.
  • The banks approved all four on stated income, with no income documents.
  • Your personal file sets what every company you own qualifies for. It does that through ONE card: your highest-limit card that's been open two years or more.
  • Which card that is, its limit and how long it's been open are all printed on your report. The answer is already sitting on your file.
  • Here's how far one personal file goes. Off my own file, four different companies each got a $100,000 line, all on stated income with no income documents.
  • I picked up stacking ten years ago, back when only one person was teaching it. I still fund my own companies off my own file today.
  • For you, the work on one personal file pays you back on EVERY company you own. It pays you again on every company you add later.
  • That's ten years, hundreds of files and thousands of data points behind one simple rule. The maximum amount of funding starts with one file, worked in the right order.

MX-02 / The order

Every company's credit is built on your personal file, so that file gets primed first.

  • Our system sizes every company off one card: your highest-limit card that's two years old or more.
  • Your file gets primed and your personal funding goes out first. Then business one applies, then business two, each read on its own.
  • The applying never stops, and a business round can bring personal funding along with it.
  • So why does your personal side ALWAYS go first? Every company you own leans on that file. Our system judges a company only once your personal file is ready.
  • It comes back to that one card. Our system sizes each company off your highest-limit card that's two years old or more.
  • That card also has to clear a minimum limit. With no card like that, no company gets a business amount at all, so your file gets primed FIRST.
  • Next, your personal funding goes out. Then business one applies for its own business credit, and business two does the same after it.
  • Each company gets read by itself, and none of them get lumped into one score. Every company you add gets sized off that same card.
  • So the work on your personal file pays off on EVERY company. The applying keeps going round after round, and a business round can bring personal funding too.

MX-03 / Company age

A company's age sets its amount: half in its first year, double once it's two years old.

  • Each company you own applies for its own business credit, and our system reads it by its age.
  • An LLC you already own has its age on the state record.
  • Each company left sitting is business credit nobody has asked a bank for yet.
  • Here's what an idle company costs you. Each company you own applies for its own business credit. Our system reads each one by how OLD it is.
  • This is the companies screen from a Fundhub call. It shows personal, business one and business two, plus a button that adds one more company.
  • Age changes the amount. A company counts at half in its first year and at the full amount in year two. After two years, it counts at DOUBLE.
  • An LLC you already own has its age on the state record. If it's two years old, it counts at double when its turn comes.
  • So every company left sitting is business credit nobody has asked a bank for yet. That's capital your business goes WITHOUT for every month it sits.
  • Unlimited funding over time is real. You set aged companies up the right way, you run five to ten of them, and you give each one real revenue.

MX-04 / The circle

A partner's file adds its amount to yours, so more than one file backs your deals.

  • The Capital Blueprint comes with one partner file, for a spouse or business partner who applies alongside you.
  • Their file runs only after they give their own consent, and it gets its own checklist.
  • With more files behind you, the bigger job and the next hire get paid for with credit, and your savings stay put.
  • Here's what your business looks like once this is all working. Your file, each of your companies and a partner's file all back the same deals.
  • I tell everyone to build a funding circle: a few people whose files help fund each other's deals. I run my own deals this way ALL the time.
  • The Capital Blueprint comes with one partner file. Your spouse or your business partner can join you on the plan, applying right next to you.
  • Their file runs only after they give their OWN consent. It gets its own checklist too, so each of you knows exactly what to do.
  • Then the plan adds their amount to yours. The bigger job, the next hire and the ad budget get paid for with credit, and your savings stay put.
  • From there, your growth runs on the banks' money. Every company you add later brings its own business credit into the same circle.

MX-06 / Your call

Your strategy call finds the card that sizes your companies and where you start.

  • Your file gets read live on the call, and a soft pull leaves your score exactly as it is.
  • You see how much you qualify for based on where you're at right now, and that's where your sequence starts.
  • About six rounds make up a funding sequence, and when it's done, your next funding sequence picks up from your file.
  • Remember that one card? On your strategy call, you see which card it is on YOUR file. The soft pull we read it with leaves your score where it is.
  • You see how much you qualify for based on where you're at right now. That amount is where your funding sequence STARTS, and the bank still makes its own decision.
  • The timeline shows what comes after that. Your funding sequence runs about six rounds of applications, and the new inquiries get disputed after each one.
  • When that sequence wraps up, the next funding sequence begins on your file. Any company you've opened in the meantime applies with its own business credit.
  • So the call gives you the starting point and the plan after it. That's your personal file first, then each company, then the next sequence.
  • We work with action takers, not shoppers. If the maximum amount of funding is what you want, the call is where you see YOUR path to it.
